description: Nestled among the trees, this recently updated top-floor, 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers refined living in an unbeatable location of prime Encino. The east-facing residence is filled with natural light thanks to expansive windows and soaring ceilings that enhance the open-concept layout. Warm and tasteful design choices highlight the open living room, while the newly upgraded kitchen showcases premium appliances, a wine refrigerator, recessed lighting, Taj Mahal stone countertops, and more modern comforts. The well-designed floor plan places the two bedrooms on opposite sides for added privacy, and a private balcony with a newly installed sliding door provides a quiet retreat. Both bedrooms feature their own en suite spa-like bathrooms. Additional conveniences include an in-unit high-end stackable washer and dryer, elevator access, two side-by-side secured parking spaces, and dedicated storage. Residents enjoy low HOA dues with their resort-style amenities. Within this intimate 28-unit community, one can find a spa and sauna, fitness and recreation room, guest parking, and 24-hour controlled access. Ideally positioned just blocks from Ventura Boulevard, Encino Commons, Equinox, popular cafes, fine dining, and boutique shopping, this home also offers quick access to the 101 and 405 freeways for seamless commuting. A rare opportunity to live close to everything while enjoying the comfort of a quiet, well-kept community in the heart of Encino. This home deserves a visit, don't miss it!
